|
Créé le 27 juillet 2026
Retour à la liste
Temps de travail :
Temps plein
Type de contrat :
Durée indéterminée
Famille de métiers :
Transport et logistique / Achat et logistique
Description de l'entreprise
Our client is an international industrial group active in materials, healthcare, and life sciences.
Within its healthcare division, it focuses on technologies for bio pharmaceutical manufacturing by providing critical solutions such as
virus removal filters,
filtration systems, and bio process equipment.
It plays a key role in enabling the
safe and efficient production of biologic drugs
like vaccines and antibodies.
Description de la fonction
As a successful
Account Manager Bio process - Pharma industry - ENG
, you will have the following responsibilities:
Manage and grow
long-term relationships with existing international customers
, acting as the main point of contact (especially with procurement teams) for the sales & after sales topics.
Lead
commercial activities
such as pricing discussions, contract negotiations, and business reviews while ensuring customer satisfaction and resolving issues.
Act as a
bridge between customers and internal teams
(product, QA, logistics), translating customer needs into business insights, opportunities, and risks. You coordinate customer requests, solve issuses & handle complaints.
Perform
sales analysis, reporting, and forecasting
, contributing to budgeting and strategic planning, while maintaining CRM/ERP data.
Profil
As a successful
Account Manager Bio process - Pharma industry - ENG
, you will have the following profile:
Education: degree in Business, Life Sciences, or similar.
Experience:
6-8+ years in account management / customer relationship roles in a commercial environment.
Open to travel internationally (mainly in Europe) up to 30/40% of the time
Skills:
strong negotiation, communication, stakeholder management, and analytical capabilities (Excel, CRM/ERP tools like Salesforce/PowerBI).
Personal traits:
customer-oriented, structured, proactive, culturally adaptable, and comfortable in an international environment.
Languages:
fluent English required; other languages are a plus
Compétences linguistiques
Français (atout)
